description: ARGO was a 1.2 m balloon-borne telescope, conceived in 1987 and flown in 1988, 1990 and 1993, to measure cosmic microwave background anisotropy at angular scales around one degree.
facility_description: ARGO was a stratospheric balloon telescope for millimetre diffuse-sky measurements.
notes: NJM bands are A, B, C and D. The LAMBDA page fetched this session says the 1993 flight wavelengths were 2.2, 1.2, 0.8 and 0.5 mm and cites de Bernardis et al., Astronomy and Astrophysics, 271, 683 (1993). That page does not define the letters A, B, C and D, so no per-band fields were set. bibcode:1993A&A...271..683D did not resolve. The NASA sentence applies to data shared via NASA repositories. No ARGO transmission curve was opened there, so that sentence is not a grant for these filter curves and redistribution is unknown. No requested acknowledgement was found.
